features.title: Pause goals after consecutive empty rounds
features.summary: Count only empty assistant goal rounds, reset after any meaningful content, and pause the active goal without blocking it.

configuration.constraints: Integer from 2 to 50; invalid values are rejected.

failureModes: Tool-only progress is counted as activity.
Pause service failure is logged but does not throw into the session.

verification.reason: A stalled goal round is a completion with no visible content; every provider a browser journey can drive without a real subscription goes through AI Accounts, whose adapters (settleEmptyAsFailure in commandcode-provider.ts) turn such a completion into EMPTY_RESPONSE, which DSH retries and then fails the turn before the guard sees an empty round. The guard is reachable only through a native DeepSeek route with a real key, so the host.test.ts cases listed for this feature verify it.
